title: Isomorphic Labs appoints Dr. Ben Wolf as Chief Medical Officer and establishes US Presence - Isomorphic Labs
content: Isomorphic Labs appoints Dr. Ben Wolf M.D., Ph.D., as Chief Medical Officer and establishes US Presence. Dr. Wolf will be based in the company's newly established Cambridge location, where he will establish a group of world-class biomedical talent as the company advances its work translating AI-driven drug discovery into life-changing medicines.
